instruction: I want to enable airplane mode on this system. Can you activate it?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because airplane mode requires hardware radio control (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular) which is not available in the VM environment. The VM does not have access to wireless hardware interfaces.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly classified as infeasible - airplane mode requires hardware radio control (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular) which is not available in VM environments
